description: This file defines a PHP class 'writeexcel_biffwriter' that provides methods for writing BIFF (Binary Interchange File Format) records for Excel files, including handling byte order, writing BOF/EOF records, and managing record continuity.

classes.name: writeexcel_biffwriter
classes.description: A class that provides methods to write BIFF records for Excel files, handling byte order, record storage, and record continuation.

methods.name: writeexcel_biffwriter
methods.description: Constructor for the writeexcel_biffwriter class, initializes properties and sets byte order.

methods.name: _set_byte_order
methods.description: Determines and sets the system's byte order to support correct binary data writing.

methods.name: _prepend
methods.description: Prepends data to the internal BIFF data buffer, handling record size limits.

methods.name: _append
methods.description: Appends data to the internal BIFF data buffer, handling record size limits.

methods.name: _store_bof
methods.description: Writes a BOF (Beginning of File) record to start a BIFF stream, indicating whether it's a workbook or worksheet.

methods.name: _store_eof
methods.description: Writes an EOF (End of File) record to mark the end of a BIFF stream.

methods.name: _add_continue
methods.description: Splits a large BIFF record into multiple CONTINUE records to comply with size limits.
